name: Charlie Dean
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
description: Charlie takes a person-centred approach that utilises social-ecological systems theory, feminist and queer theories, situating the client in the world which shapes their interactions with themselves and others. Charlie has extensive experience in providing LGBTIQA+, kink-specific, and nonmonogamy and polyamory support, as well as sexual education, and completed their Master's thesis on sex and gender-diverse individuals in the polyamorous community. Charlie is a neuro-affirming, kink-inclusive, and sex work-positive practitioner with extensive experience in sex and intimacy issues. They have a strong foundation in working with trauma, including post-traumatic stress disorder, childhood and adult sexual trauma, and long term/complex trauma. Treatment areas include gender questioning support. Thursdays telehealth only; Fridays in clinic.
specialties: sexual health, LGBTIQA+, kink, BDSM, polyamory, non-monogamy, sex work, gender questioning, PTSD, sexual trauma, complex trauma, ADHD, autism, sexual dysfunction

name: Mx Mish Kumar-Jonson
title: EMDR Consultant and Principal Practitioner
description: Niram EMDR and Trauma Counselling: a team of neurodivergent, queer and/or BIPOC clinicians supporting our communities to address the impacts of their trauma through compassionate care. Clinicians use EMDR, DBR and other trauma modalities to support adolescents, adults, and couples from diverse communities, including LGBTIQASBP+, neurodivergent, and BIPOC communities. Also offers EMDR consultation, supervision and training in EMDR and Parts work.
specialties: EMDR, DBR, trauma, somatic therapies, parts work, LGBTIQASBP+, neurodivergent, BIPOC, EMDR consultation, supervision

name: Wei
title: Counsellor (Australian Counselling Association)
description: Wei is a Queer, Trans, POC, differently-Abled Counsellor with a Master's Degree in Clinical Counselling. He provides counselling sessions using lived experience and a range of counselling techniques, with great sensitivity and compassion. Wei fosters a safe, affirming, and inclusive space for folx of all ages, backgrounds, and especially for the trans and gender expansive community and members of the LGBTQIA+ community, as well as all levels of abilities and spectrums of neurodiversity. Includes meditation, non-religious spirituality, somatic based activities and music. Sessions by phone or Google Meet; face to face sessions in Frankston. Call to book a free 10min assessment.
specialties: trans, gender expansive, LGBTQIA+, neurodiversity, disability, somatic, meditation

name: Jager Corvus
title: Somatic Experiencing Practitioner & Social Work Counsellor (AASW)
description: swan riot offers an intentional, attuned, trauma informed approach that centres your lived experience and values. I mostly work with LGBTIQA+ communities, but welcome people of all sexualities, cultures, identities, genders, bodies, and disabilities. You'll be gently supported to work through relational wounds and the wider systemic pressures shaping your life, and to connect with the parts of you that have been rejected or denied. I have a deep interest in relational & social trauma and use a somatic approach that acknowledges the external forces of power and harm. All sessions online via Zoom.
specialties: somatic experiencing, relational trauma, collective trauma, LGBTIQA+, shame, emotional dysregulation, AOD
identity: queer, androgynous person; 'Over the last decade, I have lived as a non-binary, trans person who is femme-presenting.'

name: JD Mitchell
title: Art Therapist
description: Craft your Response is owned and operated by me, JD (they/them). In my work in the mental health, disability and youth sectors, I have worked closely with LGBTQIA+ clients, especially transgender young people. I have also supported clients navigating the joys and challenges of polyamory and their own relationship to the kink scene. Craft your Response recognises that your relationship to sex and sexuality are an important piece of the puzzle in your general health and wellbeing, and is proudly sex positive, kink friendly and polyamory friendly, supporting clients of all sexual orientations and relationship constellations, including aromantic, asexual, and aroace individuals.
specialties: art therapy, LGBTQIA+, transgender, sexuality, kink, polyamory, asexual, aromantic, gender inclusion training

name: Samuel Hardidge
title: Arts Psychotherapist
description: Hi, I'm Samuel (He/They/She/Any), a non-binary/genderfluid Arts Psychotherapist and artist. Creativity has always been a way for me to respond to my own mental health struggles and seek out self understanding and insight. Specializations: arts psychotherapy, trauma informed practice, developing personal symbolism, client-centred, integrative approach, parts work, LGBTQIA+ and diversity safe space. Individual and group therapy.
specialties: arts psychotherapy, trauma informed, parts work, LGBTQIA+, group therapy

name: Dani Croaker
title: Psychologist, MPsych (Ed&Dev)
description: Dani, from Diversity Psychology Centre, is a compassionate psychologist with lived experience in Autism and ADHD. They work with children, teens, adults, and families, using a strengths-based, inclusive approach. Alongside Autism, ADHD, and AuDHD, Dani conducts WPATH Assessments (gender affirming assessments for trans and gender diverse clients), and has experience treating anxiety, depression, wellbeing, identity, relationships, and self-esteem.
specialties: WPATH assessments, gender, autism, ADHD, AuDHD, identity, anxiety, depression, WorkCover

name: Dettie Onus Browne
title: Social Worker / Counsellor
description: I provide counselling for individuals, couples, and families. I have an invested interest in working with neurodivergent people, LGBTIQA+ people and their families, survivors of conversion and suppression practices, people who have used violence in relationships and people who experience complex and/or relational trauma. As a queer and trans person I bring lived experience to my work, aiming to create a safe and understanding space for individuals exploring gender, sexuality, and identity. Relationship and couples counselling for people in all types of relationships, including monogamous, non-monogamous, and non-romantic partnerships. Services in Northcote and online; free 15 minute phone consult by booking online.
specialties: individual counselling, family therapy, couples, non-monogamy, LGBTIQA+, conversion practice survivors, complex trauma, relational trauma, neurodivergent, NDIS
